summary: Daughter of Gaetano di Marino and Maria d'Ambrosio, probably a half-sister of Grazia; John's half 3rd-great-grandaunt.
bio: Concetta di Marino was a daughter of Gaetano di Marino and Maria d'Ambrosio, who was probably Gaetano's first wife; that would make Concetta a half-sister of John's ancestor Grazia di Marino and John's half 3rd-great-grandaunt. On 26 December 1855 she married Giuseppe Petriello, son of Carmine Petriello and Maria Marra.
